newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close higher on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close higher on foreign buying.

text.p: Late buying by foreign institutional investors and speculators wiped out early losses as the Delhi bourse ended higher on Thursday, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 0.98 point higher at 670.05.
"Today's session was mainly of a speculative nature as both buyers and sellers equally dominated the trading throughout the session," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria Investments.
Reliance Industries ended 4.65 rupees higher at 198.
State Bank of India gained 3.95 rupees at 222.50.
Oriental bank of commerce was 1.65 rupees up at 73.15.
